title: Chained awaits result in cyclic references and leak
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.8.dev [aac1c92f5] and prior versions.

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (aac1c92f5) - CachyOS Linux

### Issue description

When two (or more) function states are chained together with `await` statements,
they create cyclic references.
If the await chain never resolves, these cyclic references will leak.

### Steps to reproduce

Consider this snippet:
```gdscript
func A():
	var huge_object: RefCounted = create_some_huge_object()
	await B()

func B():
	some_object.queue_free()
	await some_object.some_signal # never emits
```

In this case, when `A()` is called, the two function states that get created will reference each other.
When `some_object` is freed and its `some_signal` gets cleared, the function states are leaked.
`huge_object` will never get freed either, because it is held by A's function state.

This only occurs when multiple `await` ops are chained, a single `await` will get freed as expected.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This MRP uses weakrefs to track leaked objects and display a count.
[await-leak-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30246668/await-leak-test.zip)
